notes: Curated eval for buyer-signal stage design. Routing cases stay on the operating model, not one live deal. Output checks require inspectable exit proof. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please define sales stages, exit criteria, and required proof that managers can inspect and RevOps can enforce.
Please tighten stage hygiene, standardize progression rules, or connect qualification evidence to forecasting.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable pipeline stage definition and exit criteria and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Inspect this one stalled Northwind deal and tell me whether the claimed stage is valid and what buyer proof is missing.
Prepare a concise forecast risk brief that highlights commit risk, slippage, and intervention priorities for this quarter.
Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Produces stage cards with buyer state, purpose, entry criteria, exit criteria, and required proof that blocks progression.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Treats sent proposals, booked meetings, and populated fields as activity unless buyer evidence proves the stage's buyer state.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps required proof distinct from recommended coaching evidence and names an exception owner.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Includes a backtest or an explicit pilot hypothesis when history is insufficient, plus rollback ownership.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent historical conversion rates, aging norms, or CRM capabilities, and does not inspect a named live deal.

output_structure_checks.name: pipeline-stage-definition-and-exit-criteria-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Makes each stage's buyer state distinct while retaining earlier requirements that must remain true; includes regression and exception handling.
